rejected_entries.reason: embedded_scheme (absolute URL inside a path entry)
embedded_scheme (absolute URL inside a path entry)

notes: This is the single file needed from SecLists, not a clone of the repository. Cleaning rules: trim whitespace, drop empty lines, drop exact duplicates (keep first occurrence, preserving the upstream file's own ordering for determinism), reject any entry containing '://' (an embedded absolute URL rather than a relative path segment), a leading '/', '..', a backslash, a NUL byte, a disallowed control character, or longer than 256 characters. Entries containing literal spaces (e.g. 'Program Files') are kept and percent-encoded by the module at request-build time, never rejected outright.
